$comment: V-15 fix: the /api proxy destination was http://pubudutyres.codexpress.codes,
while .env pointed at https:// for the SAME host. Every request routed through
this rewrite carries 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (src/lib/api.js:18), so the
bearer token, customer records and pricing travelled one hop in cleartext and
were readable by anyone on the path. Now https://.
V-18 fix: this file previously had no 'headers' block at all, and index.html has
no CSP meta tag, so the deployed SPA shipped with no security headers whatsoever.
The Content-Security-Policy below is the defence-in-depth layer behind the stored
XSS fixed in V-13: even if an unescaped sink is reintroduced, an injected script
cannot load external code or exfiltrate to an attacker-controlled origin.
OWASP A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures (CWE-319 Cleartext Transmission)
OWASP A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration (CWE-693 Protection Mechanism Failure)
